plugins.name: non-tech-content
plugins.description: Plain-language documentation writer — generates or rewrites any doc so a non-technical reader (exec, CEO, new joiner) can understand it. Project- and stack-agnostic.

plugins.name: check-appstore-details
plugins.description: Audit an iOS app's App Store listing against its codebase before submission, fetching current Apple policy at run time and fixing each gap one page at a time. No App Store Connect credentials.

plugins.name: prepare-handover-docs
plugins.description: Build a client-handover Google Doc for a mobile app — one native tab per area (env, Firebase, App Store, Play Store, release & rollback, overview). Detects the current project and fills each tab from the repo plus a few things only you know, one step at a time, confirming before each write. React Native and Expo. No secret values in the doc.

plugins.name: update-docs
plugins.description: Analyze any project and build, restructure, or gap-fill its documentation as an audience-split tree written from the code — proposing the tree first, then working one approval-gated section at a time. Stack-adaptive (mobile / web / backend / library / CLI / monorepo). Stamps checkable front-matter, links to the canonical rule file instead of restating it, moves docs with git mv, and verifies links before each hand-back.
